description.en-US: Apps by Sovereign Edge Inc. for GrapheneOS and Pixel. Pocket Agent, a private on-device Claude agent; Pocket Pantry, a pantry, grocery cart and Claude recipes app; and Pocket Concierge, an offline HTML itinerary viewer with Claude.

summary.en-US: Offline viewer for self-contained HTML travel itineraries, with Claude

description.en-US:
Pocket Concierge keeps your travel itineraries on the phone as single HTML files and shows them offline.

* Library of itineraries imported with the file picker, "Open with", or Share from Chrome, Drive, Claude or a file manager
* Each itinerary keeps its own checklist progress (localStorage, scoped per file) across restarts; pull down to reload
* Directions links open natively in Google Maps; other links open in their own apps
* Generate with Claude: describe a trip and get a finished itinerary, unlocked once you add your own Claude API key
* Claude connector: an MCP server on the phone that lets Claude Code or the Claude app on your computer list, read, add and revise itineraries over your VPN (Tailscale) or USB, protected by a token
* Follows system dark mode, edge-to-edge

Everything is stored on the phone. The API key and connector token are encrypted with the Android Keystore.

NonFreeNet.en-US: Generating itineraries requires an Anthropic API key; your trip brief is sent to Anthropic's Claude API. Itineraries may load Google Fonts.
